title: Why Does My Dishwasher Smell Bad?

seo.title: Why Does My Dishwasher Smell Bad?
seo.meta_description: Dishwasher odor usually comes from the filter, food debris, standing water, or drainage. Remove the source and separate appliance odor from sewer odor.
seo.search_intent: Find the cause of dishwasher odor and correct filter, debris, or drain problems before relying on fragrance or harsh cleaners.

excerpt: A smelly dishwasher usually needs the odor source removed, not covered up. Start with the filter, tub floor, and drain path.
content_html:
Dishwasher odor usually comes from wet food residue or water that is not draining correctly. A perfumed cleaner may hide the smell briefly without fixing the source.

Remove and clean the filter if it is user-serviceable

Follow the manual, lift out the filter, remove debris, and rinse it. Clean the accessible sump area without inserting tools into the pump.

Look for debris around spray arms and seals

Seeds, labels, and small food pieces can collect in hidden areas. Clean surfaces with the appliance cool and never combine incompatible chemicals.

Check whether water remains after a cycle

A small amount below the filter can be normal on some designs. A visible pool in the tub or dirty water flowing back suggests a drainage issue.

Separate food odor from sewer odor

If the smell also comes from the sink, inspect the trap and dishwasher drain connection. In North American installations, a garbage-disposal connection or air gap can affect drainage; follow the local setup and appliance instructions.

Allow some drying between uses

After unloading, leaving the door slightly ajar can reduce retained moisture if the manufacturer permits it and it is safe in your household.

faq.question: Does water under the filter always mean a clog?
faq.answer: No. Some models retain a small amount, but a pool in the tub or dirty backflow needs investigation.

faq.question: Can I mix bleach and vinegar in the dishwasher?
faq.answer: No. Never mix incompatible cleaners; follow the appliance manufacturer’s cleaning method.

faq.question: What if it smells like a sewer?
faq.answer: Check the sink trap and drain connection too because the odor may originate in the plumbing.
